title: Treasury liquidity-support buyback operation (10-20Y nominal, 1:40pm ET)
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Buyback Operations (August 2026 refunding quarter, SEPTEMBER REVISION, masthead "For Publication September 9, 2026"), PDF text layer decompressed direct 2026-09-15 (plain curl, HTTP 200, 89,250 bytes, md5 c49a5351bf2d31a367817abc62be51bd — a different document from the 125,547-byte / md5 79b65955 August-5 one earlier fetches read) — the row reads verbatim announce 10/14/2026, operation 10/15/2026 1:40 pm - 2:00 pm, settle 10/16/2026, Liquidity Support, Nominal Coupons 10Y to 20Y, maturity range 10/16/2036 - 10/15/2046, min $0, max "= or > $4 billion". Stays estimate on two counts: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and the confirming primary is the 10-14 operation announcement rather than this document. Re-verified at the primary 2026-09-15
notes: THE MAXIMUM IS PUBLISHED ONLY AS A FLOOR, NOT A NUMBER. The September 9, 2026 revision of the buyback schedule (fetched direct 2026-09-15) replaced the superseded $2B on this row with "= or > $4 billion", the same wording it uses for every long-end row (09-24, 10-01, 10-15, 10-27, 11-04); 7-10Y, 2-3Y and 1Mo-2Y rows keep a hard $4B and TIPS rows $500M/$750M. So no dollar figure for this operation is computable before the 10-14 announcement. Press release sb0607 (2026-08-19) set the floor: the $2 billion maximum "will be at least $4 billion per operation... effective September 9, 2026 and will be in effect for the remainder of this refunding quarter (through November 4, 2026)." What the floor is worth in practice: the first operation under it, 2026-09-10 in this same 10-20Y sector, announced a maximum of $6.000B — the first $6B liquidity-support operation ever run, 50% above the floor — drew $10.489B of offers (cover 1.75x) and Treasury accepted $5.187B, i.e. 86.4%, the sector first non-full fill in 26 operations, spread across 23 of 40 eligible issues against 1-5 in every prior 2026 operation here. Why it earns a slot: it shares its date with treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-10-15 (~11:00 ET) plus ppi-2026-10-15 and retail-sales-2026-10-15 at 08:30, which is what makes its own tape effect unmeasurable, and it is one of the last operations under the enlarged regime before the 11-04 refunding resets it. Read-it-do-not-trade-it: `symbols: []`, no house playbook is macro-keyed, and a liquidity-support operation is a demand-side mechanic, not a price signal. Discovered during the treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-10-15 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05).
